No prior model decision existed in MEMORY.md for this ticker. Fresh build, NOT an update: the prior 2026-06-25 file is superseded on inputs (see below), so no reconciliation bridge is emitted. HORIZON 10 years because the owner-FCF margin is still moving (base Y1 31.6% -> Y10 28.5%). *** NET CASH -- THE MATERIAL CORRECTION *** The prior DCF used net_debt -39,859.7 (narrow cash and equivalents only), omitting time deposits and short-term investments, which are the BULK of NetEase's treasury. Company-stated net cash at 2026-06-30 is RMB167,496.0m, reconciling exactly from the balance sheet: cash 22,814.5 + current time deposits 101,978.6 + restricted cash 4,447.5 + short-term investments 50,599.6 + non-current time deposits 260.0 - short-term loans 12,604.2. That is RMB52.0/ordinary share = HK$56.1, about 29% of the HK$192.20 price -- the single largest input error in the prior file. *** HAIRCUT JUDGEMENT *** I do NOT take the full RMB167.5bn into the bridge. Three itemised deductions, total 10.4%: (1) restricted cash RMB4,447.5m EXCLUDED entirely -- it is by definition not available to shareholders; (2) short-term investments RMB50,599.6m taken at 90% (-RMB5,060m) for mark-to-market risk, which is not hypothetical: the Q2-2026 net income drop to RMB7.0bn from RMB10.7bn in Q1 was driven by declines in the fair value of equity security investments and impairment provisions, i.e. this book demonstrably moves against shareholders; (3) a 5% blanket repatriation/trapped-cash friction (-RMB7,899m) on the remainder, reflecting the 10% PRC withholding tax on dividends out of onshore subsidiaries applied to a partial-repatriation assumption. Result: net_debt -150,089.1. Both figures are recorded so a reader can flex the judgement; using the full stated figure would add about RMB17,407m = RMB5.40/share = HK$5.83/share to every scenario. *** INTEREST INCOME *** stripped from the FCF base (RMB3,953.5m FY2025, net) because net cash is ~3.5x the owner-FCF base -- leaving it in while adding the cash pile to EV would count the treasury twice. Its matching asset is exactly the net-cash bridge above, so the section-7(d) pairing holds. *** MINORITY INTEREST *** Youdao (NYSE: DAO) and NetEase Cloud Music (HKEX: 9899) are separately listed subsidiaries, so an NCI exists, but it is charged ONCE and it is small: FY2025 comprehensive income attributable to NCI and redeemable NCI was a LOSS of RMB932.6m (i.e. NCI absorbed losses, it did not drain profit), and redeemable NCI on the balance sheet is only RMB91.3m. The flows are anchored to consolidated operating income while the valuation is divided by the parent share count; no separate NCI stock deduction is taken because the NCI carrying value is immaterial (<0.1% of equity value) and taking both would double-charge. *** LEASES *** No lease adjustment: NetEase is a US-GAAP 20-F filer, operating lease cost is already inside operating expenses, and lease liabilities are excluded from total_debt -- one treatment, consistently applied. *** WACC *** 10.5% for ALL THREE scenarios, built from RMB-denominated inputs, not a USD rate: China 10yr government yield ~1.8% plus an equity risk premium of ~6.0% plus a ~2.7pp China-tech regulatory/geopolitical premium. Risk is charged ONCE -- in the flows via probability-weighted scenarios -- so no per-scenario WACC differences (the prior file used 10/11/13% by scenario, which charged regulatory risk a second and third time).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: management guidance and H1-2026 actual, cross-checked against revenue CAGRs
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: YES -- FLAGGED. Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR (27.5%) is 23.3pp above revenue 3yr CAGR (4.2%), far beyond the 30%-relative divergence threshold, and equity 5yr CAGR (6.3%) is below revenue. The gap is margin expansion plus working-capital timing, NOT volume growth, and it is why the growth driver is deliberately NOT taken from the FCF CAGR. Projecting 27.5% FCF growth off a 4.2% revenue base would compound a one-time channel-mix margin gain forever. The base case instead grows revenue at 7.5% decelerating to 3.0% and lets margins drift DOWN slightly.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs computed on the OWNER-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less net interest income) for consistency, per method section 1, using 20-F figures: FY2020 owner FCF 19,570.5 / FY2022 20,285.1 / FY2025 42,073.3 on OCF less capex of 23,832.6 / 25,609.0 / 49,674.4. 3yr = FY2022->FY2025, 5yr = FY2020->FY2025. EPS CAGRs use the REBUILT diluted-RMB-per-ordinary-share column (FY2020 3.60 ... FY2025 10.48); the pre-rebuild column matched no real share basis. WARNING on FY2025 FCF quality: the FY2025 OCF of RMB50.7bn included an RMB8.4bn working-capital inflow (contract liabilities +5.4bn, payables +1.9bn, taxes payable +1.1bn) equal to 16.9% of reported FCF and ~116% of the FY2025 revenue increase. That is the single most important reason the forward model uses a 35% working-capital capture rate rather than carrying the FY2025 owner-FCF margin of 37.4% forward.

base.rationale: Base case follows management's own framing: mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth (H1-2026 actual +7.0%), decelerating to 3% by Y10 as the China gaming market matures and the international titles move from launch surge to steady live-service. Adjusted EBITDA margin starts at the TTM 41.0% and drifts DOWN to 40.0% -- the Q2-2026 gaming gross margin of 76.1% (from 70.2%) is a genuine structural gain from lower platform revenue-sharing, but assuming it compounds further would be extrapolating a one-time channel-mix shift. Cash tax ramps 22.0% -> 24.0%: the H1-2026 effective rate of 21.7% (vs 15.0% in H1-2025) is treated as STRUCTURAL, reflecting expiring preferential software/HNTE rates, not a timing blip. Working-capital capture cut to 35% of the revenue increase, far below the ~116% of the FY2025 revenue delta that the contract-liability/payables/tax-payable inflow actually represented -- that RMB8.4bn inflow was 16.9% of reported FCF and is not repeatable at that rate.

bull.rationale: Bull case: Where Winds Meet (100m+ cumulative players, Xbox/Game Pass since June 2026) and Marvel Rivals (#2 on Steam globally) both convert into durable multi-year evergreen franchises, and the Ananta / Blood Message / Sea of Remnants pipeline lands at least one further global hit, holding revenue growth at 8-10% for five years. The platform revenue-sharing benefit proves to be a permanent step-change, letting adjusted EBITDA margin RISE from 42.0% to 43.5% as international self-published mix grows. Tax settles at 22% as preferential rates are partly renewed. NPPA approvals continue running ~19% ahead of prior year, removing the licensing bottleneck.

bear.rationale: Bear case names the actual downside axes, not generic weakness: a December-2023-style regulatory reversal (that draft rule cut the stock 28% in a single session) or a China consumer-spending slump stalls domestic gaming; Marvel Rivals churns out against Overwatch 2 / Valorant as hero-shooters historically do; Sea of Remnants' rocky China launch (criticised learning curve) proves representative of the wider simultaneous pipeline; and the AI investment gap versus Tencent (~RMB85.8bn 2025 R&D) and miHoYo (RMB100bn over three years) erodes NetEase's relative development velocity. The load-bearing bear assumption is MARGIN, not volume: the platform revenue-sharing gain REVERSES, adjusted EBITDA margin falling 39.0% -> 33.0%, back toward the FY2022-23 level. SBC rises as a share of revenue (3.0% -> 4.0%) because retention grants do not shrink. Tax stays at 25% statutory. REVISED 2026-08-29: revenue now decays 5.0% -> 2.0% rather than going flat-to-NEGATIVE from Y3 (the prior path was 3.0, 1.5, 0.5, 0.0, -1.0, -1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0). Reason: game revenue has never fallen in the recorded series -- FY2020 +15.2%, FY2021 +16.4%, FY2022 +14.4%, FY2023 +5.9%, FY2024 +8.2%, FY2025 +10.1%, worst observed year +5.9% -- and FY2019's -7.5% TOTAL revenue year came from the 9-month NPPA licensing freeze, after which gaming resumed compounding immediately. Fantasy Westward Journey (2003) still drives growth 23 years on and >90% of gaming revenue is self-developed, so the installed base is an annuity rather than a figure re-earned each year from new releases. The prior path charged franchise collapse AND margin reversion together; the evergreen annuity is the part of the thesis with two decades of evidence behind it, so the bear now stresses the two-quarter-old margin gain alone. This RAISES bear IV HK$144.56 -> HK$162.54 and weighted IV HK$227.33 -> HK$231.82.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 25% from the 15% house default, funded out of bull (25% vs 35%). Two reasons specific to this company: (1) Chinese gaming carries a genuine discrete-policy tail -- the December 2023 draft regulation cut the stock 28% in one session and the government retains that discretion over ~70-75% of revenue; (2) the entire base-case margin story rests on ONE mechanism, the platform revenue-sharing cost reduction that took gaming gross margin from 70.2% to 76.1% in a year, and a single-mechanism margin gain can reverse as fast as it arrived. Bull trimmed because it needs several independent things to go right at once -- Where Winds Meet AND Marvel Rivals both proving evergreen, plus a further pipeline hit, plus the margin gain proving permanent. Weights sum to 1.00.
probability_weighted.notes: weighted_iv is denominated in HKD, the QUOTE currency of the primary listing 9999.HK, per the canonical-weighted-iv rule. Recomputes as 0.25*162.54 + 0.50*232.24 + 0.25*300.27 = HK$231.82. BAND POSITION IS NEGATIVE AND THAT IS A REAL READING, NOT A FORMULA ARTEFACT: the price of HK$192.20 sits BELOW the house (fully-SBC-expensed) IV of HK$231.82, so the numerator is legitimately negative. The large magnitude is because NetEase's house/street band is unusually NARROW -- SBC is only ~2.8% of revenue, so the whole accounting-regime band is just HK$13.86 wide (231.82 to 245.68), and a HK$39.62 gap below the floor scales to -286%. The economic statement is simply: the market is paying LESS than even the strictest SBC-expensed valuation, so no part of this thesis depends on how SBC is treated. For a heavy SBC issuer the band would be most of the market cap; for NetEase it is 8% of it.

sanity_check.result: PASS. Current-price multiples all sit inside NetEase's own recomputed history and none required an assumption to be auto-corrected. At HK$192.20 the stock trades on 17.6x TTM GAAP P/E (10-year mean 22.0x, median 17.9x, range 14.0-38.3x), 3.43x book (mean 3.51x, range 2.86-3.98x) and 9.9x EV/owner-FCF against a 10-year mean EV/reported-FCF of 12.1x -- i.e. mid-range on earnings and book, cheap on cash flow. The EV-based multiples are the fairer read here because roughly 26% of the market capitalisation is net cash even after the 10.4% haircut, so the raw P/E of 17.6x overstates what is being paid for the operating business: stripping the haircut net cash, the operating business is being bought on 9.9x EV/EBIT and a 10.1% owner-FCF yield on EV. Base-case IV of HK$232.24 implies 21.3x P/E and 12.7x EV/owner-FCF, both inside the historical range rather than beyond it. Two conditions tripped and are disclosed rather than suppressed (upper-half price, implied exit multiple above current) -- neither is disqualifying, and the second is the honest statement that the base case needs a modest re-rating to work.
sanity_check.diagnosis: The model is NOT relying on heroic growth: base revenue growth of 7.5% decelerating to 3.0% is at or below management's own mid-to-high-single-digit framing and below the 8.9% five-year revenue CAGR, and the base EBITDA margin path drifts DOWN, not up. The valuation is carried by three things a reader can check independently: (1) a very large net cash balance, RMB150.1bn after haircut, worth HK$50.32 per share or 26% of the price -- this is the correction that most distinguishes this build from the prior one, which understated it by RMB128bn; (2) an owner-FCF yield on EV of 10.1%, which is high in absolute terms for a business still growing mid-single-digit; (3) a deliberately conservative forward margin, with the component build producing a Y1 owner-FCF margin of 31.6% against a TTM ACTUAL of 36.8% -- the model gives back 5.2pp of realised margin because roughly RMB4.4bn of TTM cash flow was working-capital and non-cash timing rather than repeatable earnings. The principal risk is not in the arithmetic but in the single-mechanism margin story: if the platform revenue-sharing gain that lifted gaming gross margin from 70.2% to 76.1% reverses, the bear case at HK$162.54 (-15.4%) is the relevant number, which is why bear carries a 25% weight.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Intrinsic value is estimated as the present value of ten years of OWNER free cash flow plus a terminal value, discounted at a 10.5% RMB-built WACC, with a haircut net-cash balance added in the bridge and the result divided by a flat fully diluted ordinary share count. Owner FCF is reported free cash flow less stock-based compensation less net interest income: SBC is a real cost to shareholders and is expensed in the flows (with the share count therefore held FLAT, never both expensed and diluted), and interest income is stripped because the cash pile that earns it is added separately to enterprise value -- leaving both in would count the treasury twice. Forward margins are built from components each year (adjusted EBITDA, less SBC as a declining-to-stable percent of revenue, less D&A, taxed at a ramping CASH rate, less capex, plus working capital on the CHANGE in revenue) rather than by carrying the latest year's margin forward, which for NetEase matters a great deal: the FY2025 owner-FCF margin of 37.4% embedded an RMB8.4bn working-capital inflow equal to about 116% of that year's revenue increase, and projecting it flat would have assumed that windfall repeats in perpetuity.
key_choices: Model routed to owner-FCF DCF because NetEase is an asset-light, cash-generative operating company (gaming ~83% of revenue, capex under 1% of revenue), the default operating-company row of the routing table.

Net cash haircut 10.4% (RMB167.5bn stated -> RMB150.1bn used): restricted cash excluded entirely, short-term investments at 90% for demonstrated mark-to-market risk, and a 5% repatriation friction on the remainder for PRC withholding tax on onshore dividends. Both figures recorded so the judgement can be flexed.

Effective tax rate treated as STRUCTURALLY higher (ramping 22.0% -> 24.0%) rather than reverting to the 14-15% of prior years, because the H1-2026 jump to 21.7% reflects expiring preferential software/HNTE rates, not a timing item.

The Q2-2026 net income fall to RMB7.0bn is treated as non-operating (investment fair-value declines, impairments, tax), NOT as operating deterioration -- operating income margin actually rose to 40.2% on opex growth of just 1.5%.
A single 10.5% WACC across all three scenarios: risk is charged once, in the probability-weighted flows. The prior file's 10/11/13% per-scenario WACC charged regulatory risk two further times.
Terminal value is max(0, min(Gordon, 18x)); the cap is set at 18x rather than the 20x default for the China regulatory discount. Gordon bound in all three scenarios.

valuation_summary.investment_recommendation: NetEase is moderately undervalued at HK$192.20 (US$122.76 per ADS). The probability-weighted intrinsic value is HK$231.82, about 20.6% above spot, with a base case of HK$232.24 (+20.8%), a bull case of HK$300.27 (+56.2%) and a bear case of HK$162.54 (-15.4%). This is a materially more conservative conclusion than the prior 2026-06-25 model despite that file understating net cash by RMB128bn, because the prior model carried the FY2025 owner-FCF margin forward flat and used a 15%-style FCF growth assumption; this build gives back 5.2pp of realised margin as unrepeatable working-capital timing and lets margins drift down in the base case. The investment case does not depend on the growth narrative: at 9.9x EV/owner-FCF and a 10.1% owner-FCF yield on enterprise value, with 26% of the market capitalisation in net cash even after a 10.4% haircut, the operating business is being bought cheaply relative to its own decade of trading. What the buyer is underwriting is durability of the platform revenue-sharing margin gain and the absence of a Chinese regulatory reversal. The 15%-hurdle weighted entry price is HK$186.38, roughly 3% below spot -- so today's price offers a good but not exceptional risk-adjusted entry; a fall toward HK$183 or below would clear the hurdle on a probability-weighted basis.
